category_edits.rationale: Add an identity residual connection around the GRU stack, whose input and output dimensions already match. This preserves recent item information while the GRU learns contextual corrections. Apply the same residual in training and inference; the generated predictor already imports this model class directly. Preserve embeddings, readout, scoring, loss, optimizer, and all four dataset models.
